name: Sauternes & Barsac

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Botrytis cinerea, a fungus that shrivels ripe grapes and concentrates their sugar when damp weather gives way to dry. If the wet weather lasts, it turns into harmful grey rot.

In 1855 brokers ranked Bordeaux estates by reputation and price. Reds were ranked from first to fifth growths, nearly all in the Médoc, and the sweet whites of Sauternes and Barsac from superior first growth to second growth.

notes: Plain Bordeaux AOC wines are fruity, with little oak, and are made to drink young.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux wine area made up of the Sauternes and Barsac appellations.
